_comment: Source of truth for the Brodmann map: which cortical areas exist, where they are drawn in each view, and which areas each sign localizes to. Edited by hand, validated by tools/validate_data.py, rendered by generator/brain_atlas.py.

insula.label: INS
insula.name: Insular cortex (deep to the fronto-parieto-temporal operculum)

12.sign: Late forced/tonic head version (>30s, sustained, contralateral)

14.sign: Figure-of-4 sign (extended arm + flexed arm asymmetric tonic)

25.sign: Ictal aphasia / speech arrest during seizure

28.sign: Simple auditory aura (tones, buzzing, hissing, roaring)

29.sign: Complex auditory hallucinations (formed music, songs, melodies)

31.sign: Auditory illusions (sounds distorted in quality, loudness, or distance)

35.sign: Formed semantic visual hallucinations (faces, people, scenes, objects)

45.sign: M2E automatism (mouth-to-hand: ipsilateral hand moves to mouth)

46.sign: Chapeau de gendarme sign (bilateral forced lip-corner retraction)

47.sign: Ictal pout (perioral dystonic protrusion/pursing - distinct from chapeau)

49.sign: Speech arrest / ictal mutism (dominant SMA, inhibitory)

50.sign: Bilateral leg elevation with cycling/pedaling movements

51.sign: Nocturnal brief stereotyped seizures (rapid onset/offset, minimal postictal)

56.sign: Hypermotor agitated behavior (ACC-dominant type with emotional coloring)

61.sign: Ictal negative motor phenomenon (inhibitory arrest of contralateral limb)

62.sign: Somatosensory aura (tingling, numbness, paresthesia - contralateral, somatotopic)

63.sign: Somatosensory Jacksonian march (sensory spread through somatotopic map)

73.sign: Elementary visual phenomena (phosphenes, flickering lights, geometric forms, fortification spectra)

75.sign: Colored visual elementary hallucinations (yellow, red, blue, multicolored)

80.sign: Moving visual phenomena (motion-specific: moving dots, patterns, streams - without form)

81.sign: Geometric formed visual hallucinations (grids, kaleidoscope, checkerboards - without semantic content)

93.sign: Bilateral asymmetric tonic seizure (BATS) at secondary generalization

94.sign: Temporal seizure semiological sequence (orderly progression: aura->arrest->oral->manual->dystonia)

95.sign: Hypermotor vs. hypomotor distinction (primary semiological axis for lobe of origin)

96.sign: TIRDA (Temporal Intermittent Rhythmic Delta Activity) - scalp EEG interictal

99.sign: Axial tonic posturing (trunk extension or flexion)

107.sign: Asymmetric terminal seizure activity (ending clonus/version ipsilateral to focus)

108.sign: Immediate postictal speech (rapid resumption of speech right after seizure end)

112.sign: Ability to warn at seizure onset (preserved aura reporting)

unmapped.110: peri-ictal urinary urge - the record states no lobar localization
